semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact identity, cost, types, loyalty, optional shared target and plus-one presentation.
The minus-two is one untargeted combined counter instruction with the printed cost and presentation.
The minus-seven has the printed cost and creates the exact prevention emblem.
The actual loyalty ability permits no target and pays its cost.
Either player's creature can receive the bonus, which survives the source leaving.
A noncreature target is rejected and a changed target incarnation is not modified.
Actual combat demonstrates first strike, vigilance and lifelink; the bonus expires at cleanup.
Current control, rather than ownership, determines the recipient set.
Real Bello and Lattice make both walkers creatures; real Lae'zel and Doubling Season yield paired 4/4 or 3/3 in the two orders.
The loyalty exclusion follows the source generation while an animated source still receives its creature counter.
A borrowed surviving creature receives the already modified counter proposal after the ability controller leaves.
A removed recipient is pruned and remaining replacement choices resume and finish once.
A real Banishing Light observer suspends and restores the begun batch with its accepted replacement intact.
The actual ultimate creates a public emblem after Ajani dies to the loyalty cost.
The emblem protects its player and their planeswalker, not unrelated recipients.
Separate actual Lightning Bolts each leave one damage.
Actual Stomp prevents the emblem from preventing damage for the turn.
Actual Nebula Dragon and Gratuitous Violence produce 3-to-1-to-2 or 3-to-6-to-1; source-free emblem and real source metadata are distinct.
Two emblems have independent opaque applications for each damage event and reject invalid answers.
Labeled synthetic control and type effects demonstrate the current derived planeswalker scope.
Two attacking creatures deal one each and Child of Night gains life from damage actually dealt.
A departing emblem controller loses the marker and prevention; the surviving walker owner receives a refreshed choice and stale input is rejected.
Actual emblem creation, damage, replacement choice and a subsequent action replay as accepted encoded commands.
